server.description: The factory's front: hand it what is missing (a functional contract), it opens a task; it builds with the workshop's slots and ends by proposing to the station
server.instructions: Ask with a functional contract (what must be produced, under which constraints, from which observations and data), never with a solution. The factory proposes to the station; it registers nothing and never touches the board.

request.title: Ask the factory for what is missing
request.description: The functional contract of what you lack: the outputs a plan must produce (name, quantity, unit, horizon), the constraints (a residual threshold and its window), what you observed (volumes, door, occupancy, scrubbers), the data available (telemetry files with their columns), the topics and a budget. The factory opens a workspace, writes the task file and the data you hand it (rows or text, with their sha256), returns the task id and starts its loop on the task at once (run: false only opens the task); the loop ends by proposing to the station, which asks the twin's judgment. Ask for the need, never for a solution; follow the task with `task`.

properties.objective: what must be produced and under which constraints: required_outputs and constraints
properties.observations: what you saw: volumes, door, occupancy, scrubbers with their speed and current
properties.data: files of telemetry the factory may use: file and columns, and either rows (objects, written as JSON) or text, or a sha256 when the file is already in the workshop
properties.profile: the profile the loop runs with
properties.run: false to open the task without starting the loop (default true)
properties.objective.required_outputs: the outputs a plan must produce: name, quantity, unit, horizonMinutes

task.title: Where a task stands
task.description: The state of a factory task (created, running, done, proposed, accepted, rejected, failed), its workspace, the sha256 of its task file, how many files it holds, its manifest when the loop has written one (every step with its source, outcome, reward and reason; the artifacts with their sha256; the proposal), and, while the loop runs here, the builder and the last stage reached.

properties.taskId: the task id returned by request
